next_step: Finalize pilot pricing and kickoff POC; infra deep-dive with Returnsphere infra; schedule streaming/TO tool-calling test
notes: Profile: mid-market e-commerce platform focused on post-purchase support (returns + shipping). ~350 employees, multi-region storefronts. Heavy seasonality (holiday peaks ~3-4x baseline).

Primary goal: replace slow human triage on returns with an agent that can look up orders, generate return labels, and answer shipping questions via chat + tool calls. High accuracy for order lookup actions and strict p95 latency SLOs.

Initial engagement: demo 2026-02-18 (hosted API streaming + tool-calling). Liked streaming for perceived UX; tool-calling for order lookup shown as core requirement. Quote from Head of Product: "Must not add >200ms p95 to existing web-chat experience during peaks."

POC plan: 4-week pilot using Hosted API to validate streaming & tool-calling integration. Success metrics: p95 <= 300ms at 2x baseline traffic; tool-call success rate >= 95% for order lookup endpoints; graceful degradation to smaller model variant under overload.

Later phase: move to Dedicated for predictable throughput during peak cycles; requirements: VPC connectivity, KMS, audit logging, and ability to pin model versions for regressions. Wants reserved burst capacity for Black Friday/Cyber Week.

Technical concerns raised by engineering: cold-starts for the first token with large context, KV cache effectiveness for repeated return-status queries, and tokenization/response size variability across confirmations. Also concerned about cost model for high token volumes during peak season.
Security/legal: submitted security questionnaire 2026-02-24. Asks for SOC2 + data residency options for EU customers; Redwood provided security FAQ (drive link).
Pricing: initial ballpark from AE: pilot credits + monthly committed throughput. Ask to provide detailed peak throughput pricing before POC kickoff.
Quote from CTO on 2026-02-25 call: "If we can hit p95 SLO without huge cost increase, we can move to reserved capacity for peak weeks."

Requested features to demo in POC: streaming partial responses, explicit function/tool calling example (order_lookup, create_return_label), fallback routing to smaller model, and dashboard SLO traces (p95 over time, burst behaviour).
Internal stakeholders: Head of Product (decision-maker), CTO (technical signoff), Legal (sec questionnaire), Ops (integrations). AE to drive pricing + pilot terms. SE to run infra deep-dive.
Current sentiment: positive but cautious. Interested in Redwood for unified path from Hosted -> Dedicated; main blocker is concrete peak pricing and verified latency under load.
